data.name: Prabakar
data.gender_notes: Prabakar is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Prabakar is derived from the Sanskrit words prabha, meaning 'light', and kar, meaning 'action'. This name signifies that the individual is a beacon of God's light, illuminating the world around them through their actions. The name Prabakar carries the meaning “Light of God” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Tamil, Telugu. Parents who choose Prabakar usually hope their child will grow to embody light of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes the divine presence within an individual, inspiring them to radiate light and positivity in their actions and interactions with the world.
data.etymology: Prabakar belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Light of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Prabakar total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
